# Cheltenham Open Data

> Cheltenham Open Data — the open data hub for Cheltenham and Gloucestershire. Live local data: fuel prices, house prices, flood warnings, air quality, planning applications, GP and pharmacy listings, food bank needs, classifieds, and news.

> All data is owned by the respective data providers; no liability is accepted for the accuracy of the data. Data is aggregated daily from official sources: the Environment Agency (flood warnings), HM Land Registry and ONS (house prices), Cheltenham Borough Council (planning applications), and NHS/Ordnance Survey (GP, pharmacy and Post Office locations), DEFRA for flood and air quality reporting.

## Feeds & data sources

- [Sitemap](https://cheltenham-od.uk/sitemap.xml): Full list of site URLs.
- [Announcements Feed](https://cheltenham-od.uk/feeds/main.xml): Site announcements feed (Atom).
- [Flood Warnings Feed](https://cheltenham-od.uk/feeds/flood.xml): Flood warnings feed (Atom).
- [Daily News Summary Feed](https://cheltenham-od.uk/feeds/news-summary.xml): Daily news updates feed (Atom).
- [Cheltenham Classifieds Feed](https://cheltenham-od.uk/feeds/classifieds.xml): Classifieds feed (Atom).

## Other

- [Weather](https://cheltenham-od.uk/): Daily weather summary (temperature, wind, visibility, pressure, humidity, sunrise/sunset).
- [Farmers Market dates](https://cheltenham-od.uk/): 2nd and last Friday monthly (Jan–Nov); 2nd and 3rd Friday in December.
- [News](https://cheltenham-od.uk/news): Site news.
- [About](https://cheltenham-od.uk/about): About Cheltenham Open Data.

- [Contact](https://cheltenham-od.uk/contact): Contact the site.
- [Submit Classified Advert](https://cheltenham-od.uk/submission): Submit a classified advert.
